en.headline: LCSD Mid-Autumn lanterns light Victoria Park from 17 September
en.dek: The carnival at Victoria Park runs to 27 September, with a separate lighting display at the Cultural Centre piazza until 11 October; both are free after dusk.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Community Programmes Office will stage the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September. A separate Mid-Autumn lighting installation will stand at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza from 17 September to 11 October.

The office said lanterns would be lit from 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight on Mid-Autumn night, 25 September. Admission is free. An inclusive performance titled We Dance, We Care is scheduled for 27 September in the Cultural Centre foyer. The programme is listed as part of the Chinese Culture Festival.

Visitors may not take naked-flame lanterns, alcohol, aerosol sprays, metallic balloons or glass bottles into the sites. Entry to Victoria Park will be first come, first served, with crowd controls if needed. The office advised people who mainly want to see the lanterns to come on days other than Mid-Autumn night.

zh.headline: 康文署中秋絲燈會9月17日起亮燈維園
zh.dek: 維多利亞公園絲燈會舉行至9月27日，文化中心露天廣場光影裝置展至10月11日，黃昏後免費參觀。
body: 康樂及文化事務署社區節目辦事處將於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉辦中秋絲燈會，另於9月17日至10月11日在香港文化中心露天廣場展出中秋光影裝置。
辦事處表示，絲燈亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜12時，免費入場。9月27日將在文化中心大堂舉行《關愛舞動迎國慶》共融演出。節目列為中華文化節活動之一。
參觀人士不得攜帶明火燈籠、酒類、罐裝噴劑、金屬氣球或玻璃瓶進場。維園以先到先得方式入場，必要時會實施人流管制。辦事處建議主要為賞燈的市民盡量選擇正日以外日子前往。
